#3237 -- independent witness: DXC's own dxa -dumpreflection agrees

The primary measurement in this directory is refl3237.exe, a harness written
for this issue that walks the reflection COM vtables by hand. A reader is
entitled to ask whether the harness's vtable layout is simply wrong, in which
case every number it prints would be meaningless.

This file removes that doubt. dxa -dumpreflection is built from the DXC tree
(tools/clang/tools/dxa/dxa.cpp -> lib/DxilContainer/D3DReflectionDumper.cpp),
shares none of the harness's code, and drives ID3D12LibraryReflection through
the compiler's own headers. It reports the same thing.

The shader is control-two-params.hlsl: an exported function with TWO
parameters and a float3 return value.

    export float3 Apply(float3 input, float scale) { return input * scale; }

Note that dxa -dumpreflection can corroborate FunctionParameterCount but
CANNOT show the reported E_FAIL: D3DReflectionDumper never calls
GetFunctionParameter at all (git grep GetFunctionParameter finds only the two
implementation stubs in lib/HLSL/DxilContainerReflection.cpp -- no caller
anywhere in the repository, tests included). Reaching the E_FAIL still
requires the harness.

Paths below use the same <repo>/<triage>/<cache> placeholders as every other
artifact here; dxa.exe and dxc.exe are the ground-truth Debug build at
<repo>/build/Debug/bin. Intermediates are written to bin/, which is gitignored.
Re-run with:

    <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T lib_6_3 control-two-params.hlsl -Fo bin/two-params.dxil
    <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxa.exe -dumpreflection bin/two-params.dxil

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T lib_6_3 control-two-params.hlsl -Fo bin/two-params.dxil
[exit] 0

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxa.exe -dumpreflection bin/two-params.dxil
